# Opening times, admission prices, accessibility, and parking

## Opening Times Tabley House Collection

TABLEY HOUSE COLLECTION IS OPEN FOR THE 2026 SEASON FROM THURSDAY 2ND APRIL TO SUNDAY 1ST NOVEMBER.

DAYS OPEN: THURSDAYS THROUGH TO SUNDAYS PLUS ANY BANK HOLIDAY MONDAYS

HOURS OPEN: 1PM TO 5PM WITH LAST ENTRY AT 4.30PM

THE TEA ROOM IS OPEN ON THE SAME DAYS.

## Individual visitors

The Collection is normally open to the general public April to October, Thursday – Sunday, and Bank Holidays, from 1pm to 5pm. (If Easter occurs before April then the Collection will open for the holiday weekend).

We recommend last admission at 4.30pm to allow you to enjoy the Collection fully.

Admission prices: 
£9.00 Adult 
£4.50 Child / Student

CONTACTLESS PAYMENTS ARE PREFERRED.

Accessibility: 
Disabled access is now available to the State Rooms.

For those using the usual entrance, please note there are some uneven surfaces and steps.

Parking: 
Parking is free for visitors please follow the burgundy coloured signs.

## Group Tours

Tabley House Collection welcomes visits from organised groups and coach parties throughout the year. Our expert guides will take you through the history of the house, the family story (including some of the family gossip), and highlight some of the artworks by great British painters such as Turner, Lawrence, and Reynolds, and furniture by great British makes such as Gillow, Bullock, and Chippendale.

Size of group: 
Tabley House Collection can accommodate small groups or up to a coach load.

The cost: 
For the general guided tour the cost is £9 per person. (If the tour occurs outside normal opening hours and the number in the group is less than 15 then a minimum charge of £100 applies).

Payment: 
Contactless payments can be made on the day. Payment by cheque can also be made on the day or in advance.

Coach entry and parking: 
Coaches access the park via a separate entrance which is easier to manoeuvre (please see map). Parking is free for coaches and cars. Cars should follow the burgundy coloured signs.

Please contact the administration team if you would like to book a tour, tel: 01565 750151.
